fields.note: 2026-11-01 check: No execution 8-K (EDGAR latest 10/26 8-K unchanged), fixed rate pending. Fitch 10/28: BBB+ unchanged, lease excluded from primary leverage metric (secondary metric), EBITDA less lease amortization and interest, total debt $38 billion (9/30), no material principal repayment before 2031-07-15, leverage ~1.5x end 2026 → ~1.0x 2027 — proposal ② review input (rate) not yet available / 2026-10-27 check (8-K Item 8.01, filed 2026-10-26, event date 10/24, no exhibits): Apollo Global Management-managed entity and Master Finance Lease binding commitment letter — lessor purchases SpaceX-designated data center GPU pods and equipment for lease, tranched lease schedule duration approximately 5–5.25 years each, quarterly advance lease payments = tranched finance cost 1/20 + unpaid lease balance fixed-rate interest + operating expenses, aggregate principal approximately $40 billion, closure expected before year-end (conditional), lease commencement on GPU delivery 1H 2027. Fixed rate confirmed at pricing before Master Lease execution (pending). No mention of collateral, guarantee, call, conversion, or warrants. IR press release 10/26: Nvidia Vera Rubin, led by Apollo and Goldman (Goldman sole structuring), anchor BlackRock, GSAM, KKR advisory accounts. Difference from press reports: Bloomberg 10/23 'private bond 3 tranches, SPV off-balance' → source text 'lease schedule tranches, finance lease'. CEO 10/25 'closure' → source text commitment. Semafor 10/22 report rate (8.3%, 7.75%) remains pending / 2026-10-26 check (full text): No 8-K, CEO X post, Bloomberg SPV report / 2026-10-23 check: No 8-K, Apollo and Goldman joint arrangement. October issue division '$10 billion loan + $30 billion bond' source verified to FT 10/06. 'CDS 197.6bp' source unverified, Gokhshtein '$8.3 billion' not adopted, maintained

Wrong premise ① 'SPV off-balance sheet means no 8-K obligation' → company disclosed voluntarily Item 8.01 next business day after execution regardless of obligation ② 'CEO closure declaration = execution' → was commitment. Correction: check point is 'estimated date + 1 day (KST)' — KST morning batch reviews only through prior US business day, primary detection is measurement layer event detection, does not infer 'may not appear' based on disclosure obligation
